text:
dina: quick postmortem follow-up from the KV-eviction incident — we agreed to convert the remediation items into concrete test/eval work. listing owners & rough timelines so we can ship: 

mohit: I can own the regression suite additions for the eviction pattern. aiming for a PR in 2w. will add a dedicated prompt set + load profile.

sara: thanks — can you also add a short chaos drill to exercise eviction under degraded network? propose a 1-hour drill during the next ops window. @chi can you run the drill with oncall? :calendar:

chi: I can take the chaos drill and the promptset curation. timeline: promptset + basic regen tests in 10 days, chaos drill run in 18 days.

matt: we should make the chaos drill recurring monthly for the next 3 months to catch regressions. also want to add an SLO smoke scenario to the load tests. happy to help define thresholds.

oncall-bot: incident summary: KV eviction spike 2026-03-05T14:12Z — 15% error rate on small model in dedicated pool. See: https://redwood-infra/incident/3267

mohit: plan for the regression suite:
```
- add promptset: tests/eviction/promptset.yaml
- add load profile: tests/eviction/load_profile.json
- integrate into CI: nightly-regressions pipeline
```
I'll open WIP PR and link it here.

sara: chi — for the drill, please include an explicit rollback checklist and smoke checks; capture traces for sampling. add runbook notes to the postmortem doc.

chi: noted. will add runbook snippet to the postmortem doc and create a deck for the drill. PRs: https://github.com/redwood/evals/pull/432 (placeholder, will update)

dina: ownership recap so we have it in tracking sheet:
- Regression promptset + CI integration: mohit (due in 14d)
- Promptset curation + chaos drill runbook: chi (due in 10d for promptset, 18d for drill)
- Monthly chaos drill schedule & SLO thresholds: matt (ongoing, first run after chi's drill)
- Oncall verification during drills: sara (coordinate windows)

mohit: I'll tag tests with labels: `eviction`, `priority:high`, `blocked-by:perf-team` so they show up in the test dashboard.

matt: can we add a quick cron to the eval-runner for a targeted nightly smoke if PR merged? something like:
```
0 3 * * * /usr/bin/eval-runner --suite eviction --only-smoke
```
I can provision that if we agree.

chi: agreed — add me + mohit as approvers. I'll run a dry run in staging before the prod drill.

dina: perfect. I'll update the postmortem action table and create the remediation ticket with the owners/timeboxes. assigning owners in the sheet now: https://docs.redwood/actions/kv-eviction-postmortem

sara: thanks all. small ask — when you open PRs, include a short note about which incident pattern the test covers (recurring-eviction / seq-len-regression etc.). makes triage easier. :memo:

mohit: will do. filing PR today and setting milestone 2w.

matt: tagging oncall rotation to the monthly drill calendar now.

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: Chaos drill (eviction) tentative run 3467890280 (in ~18d)

dina: closing loop — we'll reconvene in #eng-ml 2 days before the drill to validate runbook & chase blockers. thanks! :tada:
